label: s74-roster-on
notes: s32 lineage (AGPL Tyche) with loops s33-s37: stage evidence mining and ordering, penalty suppression, free direct page reads, paragraph from the signal page only, own-announcement source, event gate, homepage brand name, headline for cut snippets.  [ours 10-14] A Public ICP gets its own discovery lane. Pooled over all 22 published rounds (6,399 judged companies) Public is the richest stage and the least contested: 20.3% against Private Equity's 2.6%, a per_icp ceiling of 88.0, present in 19 of 22 rounds, and in 8 of those not one miner in the field qualified a single company there. Nine of the ten highest scores ever recorded were built on a Public ICP carrying three to five of its five slots. edgar.py finds listed companies where they are obliged to file -- EDGAR full-text search returns the filer with its ticker, SIC industry and head office, and data.sec.gov confirms the exchange -- all free over the sandbox's web-egress bridge, so the ICP's whole budget stays with verification. sec.gov is never submitted as evidence: the judge fetches with a Chrome agent and every sec.gov host answers it 403. A company EDGAR does not show trading is dropped from a Public ICP. Evidence slots are ordered by what the judge can read on the page: judge-readable and describing the business first, unreadable last -- businesswire answers 403 to every agent, and industry blocked 1,008 of the 1,780 companies whose stage had already passed, with no field of its own. Measured on the arena-2026-10-10 Public ICP, where every miner in the field scored 0.0: five companies, two of them carrying three stage-evidence items over five distinct URLs.
